text:
alex_ops: heads-up: vendor Solace quoted 12–16wk lead time for H200s to EU. they flagged backlog + customs windows. need a mitigation plan for the capacity gap. cc @maria_procure @jenna_logistics

kevin_vendor: hey Alex — sorry about the timeline. confirmed: 12–16 weeks for full qty, but we can do a staggered partial shipment ~40% in 6–8w and the remainder on the standard window. air vs sea changes landed cost. we can offer a 3% invoice credit if you accept the split.

maria_procure: split could work. what is the per-unit delta for air expedite to EU?

kevin_vendor: air add is approx ~$8k/unit landed (includes expedited handling). sea is much cheaper but adds 3–4w on top of quoted lead time. customs hold variance ~1–2w depending on docs.

jenna_logistics: if we accept partial air, depot needs prep for incoming 20–30 units. RMA and swap lanes might be impacted — we need AWB info and depot SLA. we can absorb staging but need 48h notice from vendor prior to shipment.

alex_ops: cluster health will dip unless we top off. @kenley_sre can we shift non-latency-critical workloads to the US pool for ~4–6 weeks as a bridge?

kenley_sre: yes, we can shift batch jobs and lower-priority finetuning. estimated cost bump ~+$12k/mo (cross-region egress + spot premiums). need ops approval and a migration window.

maria_procure: @kevin_vendor can you confirm vendor credit on split and warranty alignment for early-shipped units (so we don't end up with mismatched warranty windows)?

kevin_vendor: confirm 3% credit on invoice for split acceptance, and we will align warranty on early units to match the remaining batch (6-month alignment on paperwork). we'll put that in the proforma.

alex_ops: also want vendor to cover expedited DOA swaps for early units — if early batch has higher DOA risk, we can't afford long swap windows.

kevin_vendor: agreed. vendor will cover DOA air swap costs for early shipment units for first 60 days after delivery. need your RMA contact and SLA expectation.

jenna_logistics: RMA contact for vendor: rma@solace-logistics.com. for swaps we require AWB reuse protocol and depot check-in log. i'll send the depot onboarding checklist and required fields.

alex_ops: decision proposal: accept 40% partial air shipment (6–8w) to top off capacity, remainder by sea/standard window (12–16w). maria please finalize PO with 3% credit, DOA swap coverage, and warranty alignment. kenley, start migration plan for non-critical jobs.

maria_procure: will draft PO today and circulate. need finalized proforma numbers to submit for finance approval — @kevin_vendor pls send updated proforma with split pricing and exact landed costs.

kevin_vendor: sending proforma by EOD to procurement@redwood.com and cc ops. also flag: customs doc `EUR1` is recommended for tariff relief but may delay if not prefilled — recommend you provide exporter declarations ASAP.

jenna_logistics: noted. i'll prepare exporter declarations and depot SLA draft. depot booking requires 48h notice after AWB received.

rma-bot: New RMA ticket template created: `RMA-EU-SPLIT-230501`. Use for all early-shipment DOA claims to track expedited swaps.

alex_ops: great. action items: kevin — proforma; maria — PO + finance; kenley — migration window; jenna — exporter docs + depot SLA. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

kevin_vendor: proforma sent (email).
